characters.name: TOOMAS
characters.description: Väike inimene, 5-aastane poiss tumepruunide lühikeste juuste ja sinise kootud kampsuniga. Lõbus, uudishimulik ja sõbralik näoilme. Armas multifilmistiil.

characters.name: KATI
characters.description: Väike inimene, 6-aastane tüdruk kahe blondi patsi ja kollase kootud kampsuniga. Rõõmus ja hooliv näoilme. Armas multifilmistiil.

locations.name: Toomase ja Kati köök
locations.description: Cozy children's kitchen with light cream walls, a wooden floor, a central sturdy wooden table with green wooden chairs, and a single large square window on the back wall showing a chilly late autumn garden with a bare tree. Warm indoor light, clean cozy atmosphere. Cartoon style.

locations.name: Kodu aed sügisel
locations.description: Late autumn garden with a large bare wooden tree with sturdy branches in the center, a patchy green and brown lawn with fallen autumn leaves, light frost on grass, and a simple wooden house visible in the background. Bright crisp autumn day daylight. Cartoon style.

pages.scene: Toomas in his blue knitted sweater and Kati in her yellow knitted sweater stand next to each other in the cozy kitchen, looking out the large window into the chilly autumn garden. Outside, a bare tree stands in the cold garden. Toomas points towards the window with interest. Cartoon style.

Close-up view of the window from inside the kitchen. Toomas and Kati look outside through the glass, where two small cute brown birds are sitting on the chilly wooden windowsill outside, looking for food. The children have caring expressions. Cartoon style.

Toomas and Kati sit at the wooden kitchen table. On the table sits a large pinecone, a bowl of seeds, and a small jar of peanut butter. Toomas holds a small wooden spoon, and Kati holds the pinecone enthusiastically. Warm lighting inside the cream-walled kitchen. Cartoon style.

Toomas and Kati sit at the wooden kitchen table. Kati carefully spreads seeds onto the sticky pinecone with her fingers, while Toomas pours a handful of colorful bird seeds from a bowl over it. The table has scattered seeds and pinecones. Both kids smile happily. Cartoon style.

Toomas and Kati walk outside into the garden, wearing warm outdoor coats. Kati holds the finished seed-covered pinecone feeder attached to a red string carefully in both hands. The bare tree stands ahead in the chilly autumn garden. Cartoon style.

In the garden, Toomas reaches up to hold a low branch of the large bare tree while Kati ties the red string of the seed-covered pinecone feeder onto the branch. Both look focused and happy under the autumn sky. Cartoon style.
Toomas and Kati stand a little distance back in the garden, watching the tree. Three small cheerful birds fly through the air toward the pinecone feeder hanging from the tree branch. Cartoon style.

Close-up of the tree branch. Two cute small birds are perched on the pinecone feeder, eating seeds happily. One more bird perches on the branch nearby. The red string holds the feeder securely. Cartoon style.

pages.text: KATI JA TOOMAS ON VÄGA ÕNNELIKUD.
pages.scene: Toomas and Kati stand in the garden near the tree, holding hands and smiling brightly up at the birds feeding on the pinecone. The sun shines softly through the autumn trees, creating a warm happy ending scene. Cartoon style.
